question.text: Asset allocation decisions CONTRIBUTE to portfolio returns most significantly via:

answer.text: Strategic asset allocation (~80-90% of long-term return variance)

explanation.text: The Logic: Brinson's seminal studies: SAA explains 80-90% of long-term return variance. Security selection ~5-10%. The Trap: Stock-picking is glamorous but less impactful than allocation discipline. Cross-Exam Context: Core finance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Don't obsess over stock picks if you haven't nailed SAA — focus efforts where variance is largest.
